Ik maak u graag wegwijs wanneer u een kunstwerk wilt kopen of huren.

og.description:

In studio and sculpture garden you will find a large collection of sculptures, each with its own story. You are welcome to view the images on this website.
I would like to show you around when you are interested in buying or renting a work of art.
